label_definition: duplicate means the proposed entry restates the same finding, not merely related topic or supporting evidence; never authorizes equivalence
formula: weighted set Jaccard over Unicode-lowercased alphanumeric title and substantive body tokens; equal field weights; weight(t)=ln(1+(N-df(t)+0.5)/(df(t)+0.5)); empty union scores zero
retrieval: BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75, at most 64 candidates per addition before overlap scoring

proposed_acceptance.approval: not approved; tune only development, then freeze before heldout; report misses and false warnings individually

limitations: Positive cases below are explicitly crafted replays of real entries, not observed historical duplicate nodes. Corpus pairs alone cannot establish generalization or calibrated probability. Add independently reviewed naturally occurring duplicate and deliberate verification-run pairs before publication.
